solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Press car hit unfortunately — police action results

indicators.note: an unfortunate car crash leaves things in a mess, so these three words are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A press car crashes and the police respond with an action of their own.
explanation.definitionFit: Searching a suspect's body after removing clothing is a procedure carried out by police officers.

clue.text: Constant in genuine agreement to stop fighting

indicators.note: the constant's letter is placed in the middle of the word for genuine

parts.note: genuine means true
C is the symbol for a constant, as for the speed of light in physics

explanation.surface: A sincere pact to end hostilities, with something steady at its heart.
explanation.definitionFit: An armistice or ceasefire is an agreement between sides to halt hostilities.

clue.text: Open University participating in force? Rash

indicators.note: the university's letters take part inside the word for force, sitting within it

parts.note: impetus is driving force or momentum
OU is the abbreviation for the Open University, the UK's distance-learning university

explanation.surface: Is the Open University taking part in a forceful push? That would be hasty.
explanation.walkthrough: The Open University is Britain's distance-learning university, a staple crossword abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting impulsively without thought is both being rash and being headlong; the two adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Begin small pastry

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a tart is a pastry case with a filling

explanation.surface: An instruction to start with a little pastry.
explanation.definitionFit: To commence something is to begin it; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Court after answer? Do something!

indicators.note: in this down clue the court abbreviation comes after the answer letter

parts.note: A is the usual abbreviation for answer, as in Q and A
CT is the abbreviation for court, as in street names

explanation.surface: Someone waiting to go to court after an answer is urged to take action.
explanation.definitionFit: The imperative to take action, a call to get on with things, is the verb meaning do something.

clue.text: Is able to time Qatar's core musical work

parts.note: can means is able to

indicators.note: the core of the country's name is its central letters, the outer two dropped

explanation.surface: Someone is able to time a performance of Qatar's central piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A choral composition with solos and chorus, often sacred, is a kind of musical work.

clue.text: Tenacity of sister, last to rise to top, getting in money

indicators.note: the rearranged sibling word gets inside the word for money

parts.note: pence are British coins, so money

indicators.note: in this down clue the final letter of sister climbs to the top, the front of the word

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A sister's dogged determination brings her from last place to the top and earns her money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last to rise to top' reads like a race result, but in this down clue it lifts the sister's final letter to the front, giving RSISTE.
explanation.definitionFit: Doggedly carrying on despite difficulty is tenacity; the two nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Month (number ten) on lake for titled lady

indicators.note: in a down clue, one thing on another sits above it, so the earlier pieces go before the lake

parts.note: March is a month
10 written as the digits one and zero looks like the letters I and O
Ness is the Scottish loch, Loch Ness

explanation.surface: A month spent at Number Ten, the Prime Minister's residence, then at a lake, by a noblewoman.
explanation.walkthrough: Number Ten suggests Downing Street, but it is just the figures 1 and 0 read as letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The wife of a marquess, or a woman holding that rank herself, is a titled noblewoman.

clue.text: Furnish European with witty remark

parts.note: a quip is a witty remark

explanation.surface: Supplying a European with a clever one-liner.
explanation.definitionFit: To provide someone with what they need is to furnish or supply them; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Receiver finding worker (enrolled nurse) not available

parts.note: a worker ant is the classic crossword worker
EN is the abbreviation for an enrolled nurse in the UK

explanation.surface: A hospital worker finds that an enrolled nurse isn't free to take a call.
explanation.definitionFit: An aerial picks up radio or TV signals, so it is a receiving device.

clue.text: He watches tots caper around

indicators.note: placed around the clue's end, it signals the letters of the toddlers and the frolic are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: A man watches small children romping about.
explanation.definitionFit: An onlooker is someone who watches an event, so a person who watches defines it.

clue.text: New article is down-to-earth

indicators.note: a new version of these words is made by rearranging their letters

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece described as practical and sensible.
explanation.definitionFit: Being practical and grounded in fact is being down-to-earth; the adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Bow as Biblical vessel's mentioned

indicators.note: something mentioned is spoken, so the word for the vessel is said rather than written

parts.note: Noah's ark is the vessel of the Bible

explanation.surface: A ship's bow from the vessel in the Bible gets a mention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bow' suggests the front of a ship, fitting the vessel, but here it is a curve.
explanation.definitionFit: A bow is a curved shape, like a rainbow, and a curve of that kind is the geometric term.

clue.text: Add enlivening quality to fall in US, say

definitions.meaning: to flavour food with salt or spice, giving it zest
fall is the American word for autumn, one of the four times of year

explanation.surface: Bring some liveliness to an American autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: Spicing food gives it flavour, and autumn is one of the year's four divisions.

clue.text: Price to go up bearing food?

parts.note: air is a person's bearing or manner
fare is food, as in simple fare

explanation.surface: A question whether a price rise is coming because of food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bearing' looks like carrying or a compass direction, but it is demeanour.
explanation.definitionFit: The ticket cost of a flight is the price paid to go up into the sky.

clue.text: Hunt expedition from Mombasa far inland

indicators.note: the letters are taken from within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A hunting trip setting off from Mombasa, deep into the interior.
explanation.definitionFit: An expedition to hunt or observe wild animals, especially in East Africa, is the Swahili-derived term.

clue.text: Make mistake recalling some quarrel

indicators.note: to recall is to call back, so the chosen letters run backwards
only some of the letters of quarrel are used, a run from inside it

explanation.surface: Someone gets it wrong when remembering part of an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To blunder or go wrong is to make a mistake; the verb is the formal word.

clue.text: Tommy about to persevere

parts.note: a Tommy is a British private soldier, from Tommy Atkins
on means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A British infantryman is on the point of keeping going.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy is the traditional nickname for a British army private.
explanation.definitionFit: To carry on doggedly despite difficulty is the idiom for persevering.

clue.text: Generous initial contributions from London and region greatly esteemed

indicators.note: each of the following words contributes its first letter

explanation.surface: Big-hearted early donations from London and a highly regarded region.
explanation.definitionFit: A large helping is a generous one; the adjectives share the sense of ample.

clue.text: Rake smuggling in good powder

indicators.note: the rake carries the good letter hidden inside him

parts.note: a roue is a rake, a dissolute man

explanation.surface: A libertine sneaks in some fine powder, like a smuggler.
explanation.definitionFit: Red cosmetic powder for the cheeks is the French-derived name for blusher.

clue.text: Warning light on church hall

indicators.note: the warning light goes on after the church abbreviation

parts.note: amber is the traffic light that warns before red

explanation.surface: A warning light is switched on at a church hall.
explanation.definitionFit: A large room for meetings, as in a council chamber, is a hall.

clue.text: Education graduate's place to rest

parts.note: B stands for Bachelor, the first degree a graduate holds

explanation.surface: Where a teaching graduate goes to lie down.
explanation.walkthrough: Together the pieces spell BEd, the Bachelor of Education degree held by many teachers.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhere to lie and sleep is the piece of furniture people rest on.

clue.text: Pleasure trips in French cathedral city

definitions.meaning: journeys taken for enjoyment, sightseeing excursions
a city on the Loire with a Gothic cathedral

explanation.surface: Holiday excursions in a French city with a cathedral.
explanation.definitionFit: Sightseeing excursions are the plural noun, and the Loire city of that name has a famous cathedral.

clue.text: A cheater he'd corrected?

indicators.note: corrected work is put right, so these letters are rearranged into the right order

explanation.surface: Who would have marked a cheat's work and set him straight?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the anagram and the definition: a school principal is someone who would correct a cheating pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: A school's principal teacher disciplines pupils, so correcting a cheat is part of the job.
